offer_gate: Gated by BUNDLE_WORLD_OFFERED_CAPABILITIES. Bundle World only. Extends command3 intent with field 5 aim_mode FACING=1, CURSOR=2 (with POSITION target_position), TARGET=3 (with NONE); aim_at_target must be false with it. Without selection field 5 fails closed and the old aim_at_target keeps its meaning. A wave or beam aims on a cardinal direction (east/west win ties) with the caster-adjacent origin and never turns the character. Byte bound 32 unchanged.
